newsitems.title: Week 16 - Mod Showcase
newsitems.author: RedHookMichaela
newsitems.contents:
[p]Welcome to Week 16 of the Darkest Dungeon Mod Showcase! This week’s showcase features new heroes for both Darkest Dungeon and Darkest Dungeon II.[/p][p]
If you’re a mod maker, and would like to see your work featured, or if you know of an underrated mod you think we should showcase, please fill in this Google Form: [url="https://forms.gle/rTpUoFNPv9xmDDax7"]https://forms.gle/rTpUoFNPv9xmDDax7[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]You can submit up to 3 mods for each game. If you are unable to access Google, then please email your suggestions to us at[url="https://feedback@redhookgames.com"] feedback@redhookgames.com[/url] with the subject line: Mod Showcase Submission[/p][p][/p][p][b]DARKEST DUNGEON[/b][/p][p][u][b]The Boatswain: Overhauled[/b][/u] - Jimiko, Mint, Reebalt[/p][p]The Boatswain: Overhauled is an offensive, mobile support class. Fully capable of moving not only himself, but his allies and enemies as well, he helps to ensure that everyone is in an advantageous position. Should you be faced with a formidable foe, he can help point out the weakest point of their armor for his allies. And should the situation grow more dire, he is more than willing to take a hit for his allies, or show that the anchor he carries, while no conventional weapon, can easily break those who assume this old man is unable to bear its immense weight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/236c1c23b590aa5b681610b4387800275dd8d4b0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/b855faa5e3b2a5d884f11c8406c18d7a8ae07444.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/eb33e0a745be226e094167efd63e3bdec7f589d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Workshop mod link: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3705876845"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Curious to see what we featured for our Darkest Dungeon II mod showcase? You can check it out here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1940340/view/696525626177226976"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Darkest Dungeon: The Original Canon Graphic Novel, now live on BackerKit
newsitems.author: RedHookMichaela
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/82755f3698f7f75b2357f3a0a39822b5b9326d01.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Glory and honor to that ragged band whose triumph healed the world. Unfortunately, peace has never sat comfortably beside the Darkest Dungeon.[/p][p]Today, Vault Comics and Red Hook Studios invite you to descend once again with [url="https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/vault-comics/darkest-dungeon-an-original-graphic-novel/pre-launch/?ref=rh-social"][i]Darkest Dungeon: The Original Canon Graphic Novel[/i][/url][url="https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/vault-comics/darkest-dungeon-an-original-graphic-novel/pre-launch/?ref=rh-social"],[/url] now live on BackerKit.[/p][p]This brand-new 180+ page canon adventure takes place after the events of [i]Darkest Dungeon II[/i] and comes from writer John Lees, artist Maan House, and [i]Darkest Dungeon[/i] creative director and Red Hook Studios co-founder Chris Bourassa.[/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Caqwwz_E0xE"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3] CHOOSE YOUR EDITION[/h3][p]The graphic novel will be available in[url="https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/vault-comics/darkest-dungeon-an-original-graphic-novel/pre-launch/?ref=rh-social"] both Standard and limited Deluxe Editions[/url], each containing the same complete 180+ page story and eligible bonus material unlocked during the campaign.[/p][p]But the Deluxe Edition is not yet finished![/p][p]Additional production treatments and hidden upgrades are scattered throughout the expedition, waiting to be discovered.[/p][h3]EXPLORE THE DUNGEON[/h3][p]The campaign itself has become an expedition.[/p][p]As we complete objectives, we will progress through a dungeon map filled with rewards, upgrades, secret rooms, and challenges.[/p][p]Our opening path has been set. What happens after that? That will depend on the expedition.[/p][p]Backers will eventually determine which paths we take through the dungeon and which secrets we pursue. So gather your courage, provision wisely, and remember:[/p][p]Curiosity is a dangerous bedfellow… yet no great deed was ever wrought without it.[/p][p]Join the expedition on BackerKit Now: [/p][p][url="https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/vault-comics/darkest-dungeon-an-original-graphic-novel/pre-launch/?ref=rh-social"]https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/vault-comics/darkest-dungeon-an-original-graphic-novel/pre-launch/?ref=rh-social[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/014a3547d2309447828b4e39602302cd177fec3a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Darkest Dungeon - Fire's Edge - Mod Manager - coming_in_hot
newsitems.author: RedHookMichaela
newsitems.contents: [p]Our new mod manager is up on coming_in_hot and ready for you to try![/p][p][/p][p][b]Darkest Dungeon Mod Manager[/b][/p][p][b]!! WARNING !! Back up your save files.[/b][/p][p]Everything's been tested thoroughly and the Mod Manager creates its own backups too, but it's always better to be safe.[/p][p][/p][p]Your save files are located here:[/p][p]Steam version: C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\userdataYOUR_ID\\262060[/p][p]Non-Steam version: C:\\UsersYOUR_USERNAME\\Documents\\Darkest[/p][p][/p][p]With that let’s get to the fun stuff! [/p][p][/p][p][b]What the Mod Manager does[/b][/p][p]The Mod Manager makes it easier to launch, organize, and set the load order of your mods. If you're happy with the classic in-game mod menu (or Sherin's Better Mod Menu), keep using it, it still works exactly the same as before.[/p][p]But if you want more control and an easier way to manage things, just (after backing up your saves) launch the Mod Manager - you'll find it right in Steam when you hit PLAY.[/p][p]The executable sits in the root folder of your Darkest Dungeon install. If you're on a non-Steam version, you can run it directly from the .exe.[/p][p]Right now the Mod Manager only works with the Steam version of the game. Other versions aren't officially supported yet.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How you can help[/b][/p][p]We'd love your feedback! What felt intuitive, what didn't, whether the HELP section gave you enough info, and any bugs or issues you run into along the way. Every bit of feedback helps. We will be using feedback to help create an Official Steam Guide that will cover most of the FAQs and how-tos for using this new tool. For now we have [url="https://discord.gg/darkestdungeon"]opened a new DISCORD channel[/url] to help coordinate discussion on using the new manager.[/p][p][/p][p][b]A few things to know[/b][/p][p]If you're running large modpacks (100+ mods), the conflict detection will currently throw a lot of false alarms. Many mods touch the same files without actually causing problems in-game, and we don't yet have a reliable way to tell harmless overlap from real conflicts. So for now, treat conflict warnings as informational only. If your game crashes, check the log to see if the manager flagged anything relevant.[/p][p]This is just the first version, we'll keep adding features and polishing the interface. Got an idea for something missing? Let us know.[/p][p]Darkest Dungeon is 10 years old now, which means some of the oldest mods are just as old. Modding guidelines came later, so some older mods don't have a proper project.xml file. If a mod is missing that file (or the required parameters in it), the Mod Manager unfortunately won't recognize it and it won't show up in the list. There's no workaround for that right now.[/p][p]And one more time... please back up your saves![/p]

newsitems.title: Darkest Dungeon - The Fire’s Edge - DLC Release
newsitems.author: RedHookMichaela
newsitems.contents:
[p]The Fire’s Edge, the first new Darkest Dungeon DLC since 2020, is now live! This DLC includes two heroes, The Runaway and The Duelist, who made their debut in Darkest Dungeon II, a new combat mechanic, unique trinkets, plus 3 more Districts.[/p][previewyoutube="elgCnwSNZcM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The team has always been interested in backporting The The Runaway and The Duelist to the original Darkest Dungeon, and with the game celebrating its 10th anniversary this year, it seemed like the perfect time to add something new! [/p][p]
Each new hero has their own unique style of gameplay: The Duelist is able to dance between ranks, while freely maintaining Riposte as she switches between two combat stances, whereas The Runaway makes use of Burn, a combat mechanic unique to her class. And don’t worry about finding room for these new additions! The Runaway and The Duelist will each expand your roster by 1 slot. The Fire’s Edge also adds a number of Trinkets with all new mechanics including Trinkets that come charged with powerful limited effects, or ones that transform through use as you complete your expeditions. Rounding out this update are some new town events, and 3 new Districts for your Hamlet: the Academie Duello, Craftworks, and Archaeological Base Camp, which offer new bounties such as weekly Heirlooms and Trinkets, as well as damage boosts to heroes.[/p][p][/p][p]You can purchase The Fire’s Edge now: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4964110/Darkest_Dungeon_The_Fires_Edge/"][/dynamiclink][b]Modding[/b][/p][p]The game has been in a stable place for several years now, so we were careful to approach The Fire’s Edge in a way that would not interfere with existing mods. The changes we’re introducing are all additive, and do not affect existing heroes or enemies. To help ensure this DLC was solid, we invited several members of the Darkest Dungeon modding community to help us test, and provide vital feedback during the development process. We owe a debt of gratitude to every single member of our test pool, and cannot thank them enough for their enthusiasm and thorough testing over the last month.[/p][p][/p][p]Today’s release should provide some exciting new toys for the mod community. The inclusion of a functioning Burn combat mechanic, plus the various Trinket mechanics in this DLC should create even more opportunities for modders to experiment and create. [b]And there is even more coming![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Our team is currently working on a new and improved mod loader, something that has been highly requested by the community for some time. In addition to this, we have considered a number of ideas pitched to us by our test pool that could improve the modding scene further, and help extend the lifespan of the product. We are hoping to implement some of these requests over the next few weeks. A [b]followup release is currently planned for the end of August[/b], and we will likely kick off an open beta for the new mod loader in the next week or so. 
[/p][p]For now, we hope you enjoy The Fire’s Edge. It was a real pleasure to return to the original Darkest Dungeon and surprise you all with this new content. Thank you again for the support![/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Week 12 - Mod Showcase
newsitems.author: RedHookMichaela
newsitems.contents:
[p]Welcome to Week 12 of the Darkest Dungeon Mod Showcase! This week’s showcase features a new path for the Crusader in Darkest Dungeon II, and more Trinkets for Darkest Dungeon.  [/p][p][/p][p]If you’re a mod maker, and would like to see your work featured, or if you know of an underrated mod you think we should showcase, please fill in this Google Form:[url="https://forms.gle/rTpUoFNPv9xmDDax7"] [/url][url="https://forms.gle/rTpUoFNPv9xmDDax8"]https://forms.gle/rTpUoFNPv9xmDDax8[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]You can submit up to 3 mods for each game. If you are unable to access Google, then please email your suggestions to us at[url="https://feedback@redhookgames.com"] feedback@redhookgames.com[/url] with the subject line: Mod Showcase Submission[/p][p][/p][p][b]DARKEST DUNGEON[/b][/p][p][b][u]Trinkets Plus (4.0)[/u] - Vintage[/b]  [/p][p]Trinkets+ is a complete and comprehensive rework of Darkest Dungeon trinkets. The full list of changes that this mod introduces are:[/p][list][*][p]
Buffs/Nerfs/Reworks of over 90% of vanilla/DLC trinkets, aimed at encouraging trinket diversity and allowing new playstyles.[/p][/*][*][p]An enforced limit of 1 on most* trinkets. Once you obtain a focus ring, you cannot obtain another unless you sell it. This will not cause issues if you had multiple copies of a trinket before installing the mod.[/p][/*][*][p]Apprentice bosses now drop Rare trinkets instead of Very Rare, making Very Rare trinkets a legitimately valuable resource that cannot be obtained early in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Very Common trinkets are now properly listed as Very Common.[/p][/*][*][p]Several new universal trinkets have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]*Among the universal trinkets added are a special class of "treasure" type trinkets. These trinkets have an increased limit so you can obtain duplicates of them (the limit is listed in game) and sell for much more gold than usual. These are made such that even if you have every single trinket in the game (which are limit 1 so you cannot get them again), you still get a trinket reward from quests in the form of extra cash.[/p][/*][/list][p]

newsitems.title: Vault Comics to publish Darkest Dungeon graphic novels
newsitems.author: RedHookMichaela
newsitems.contents:
[p]Red Hook Studios has joined forces with Vault Comics to release an all new series of graphic novels set in the Darkest Dungeon universe. [/p][p]
[b]Our heroes embark into the unknown once again! [/b][/p][p]The graphic novels will tell an original canonical story, delving deeper into the mysteries at the heart of the Darkest Dungeon core mythology. Brace yourself for the horrors that lie waiting in the encroaching dark! [/p][p]
Acclaimed writer John Lees ([i]The Nasty[/i], [i]Sink[/i]), as well as comic artist and illustrator Maan House ([i]Dark Souls: Mother of Mourning[/i], [i]The Cemeterians[/i]) will be collaborating closely with Red Hook Studios co-founder and Creative Director Chris Bourassa on this project.[/p][p][/p][p]A launch campaign for the graphic novels will kick off on BackerKit this October.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Start your support for the project today! Pre-launch sign-ups are now live:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/vault-comics/darkest-dungeon-an-original-graphic-novel/pre-launch"]https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/vault-comics/darkest-dungeon-an-original-graphic-novel/pre-launch[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Follow the campaign to receive special access to concept art, updates and more.[/p][p][/p][p]Get a first look at the project below.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/dbd250ff0641f6b7e65bd3a29c67fdfbc453409e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/71ecb6f0311269edf6f815c0e278c6e1c2b38641.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/0bb7f86c29dd889d2ce0282eaff51242998d8a12.jpg"][/img][/p]

[p][b][u]Week 11 - Mod Showcase[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]This week’s showcase features a new barks for Kingdoms militia in Darkest Dungeon II, and an overhaul of a character mod for Darkest Dungeon.   [/p][p][/p][p]If you’re a mod maker, and would like to see your work featured, or if you know of an underrated mod you think we should showcase, please fill in this Google Form: [url="https://forms.gle/rTpUoFNPv9xmDDax7"]https://forms.gle/rTpUoFNPv9xmDDax7[/url] [/p][p][/p][p] You can submit up to 3 mods for each game. If you are unable to access Google, then please email your suggestions to us at [url="https://feedback@redhookgames.com"]feedback@redhookgames.com[/url] with the subject line: Mod Showcase Submission[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]The Milkmaid Reconstructed[/b][/u] - Lone_Drifter, Woona, Mr Pepper. Other credit notes:[/p][p]Original artist from the mod is Comrade. Some rare assets from him are still used, like trinket art and skill icons. Some other assets that are still used by this mod were made from MoonKanin, like her weapons and armors. For a full list of the contributors of the original mod, please check out the original mod page.[/p][p]Made with authorization from Rehtaelle, the original creator of the mod.[/p][p] [/p][p]This mod is a complete overhaul of the Milkmaid Hero. Not only this comes with a complete visual rework, but every skill, trinket, and affliction has been changed. She is still a fierce healer, able to support a whole team on her own. However she now can even help your team in a variety of ways! Cure DoTs, protect your teammates from marks and stuns, and buff them! Milkmaid is also more proactive than ever, being able to severely disrupt and cripple her enemies with her crystalline powers.[/p][p]
DISCLAIMER : This is a standalone mod, do not use the original mod with it. It is however compatible with saves using the previous mod, to do this, simply disable the original mod and enable the new one before launching your estate. In case you prefer the old kit, a standalone skin mod is available here.[/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/09759e1fe4858210ed9382307bfbc8ad70d12276.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/97d5f51eadea7cccb63c3e49f10add994a9eb913.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/71e4c05627633a8d6d46488b63039e2448e6cf99.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3746001956"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p]Curious to see what we featured for our Darkest Dungeon II mod showcase?
